notes.title: Disc Golf City – Full Release is Here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]It’s official – [i]Disc Golf City[/i] has left Early Access![/b][/h3][p]We’re thrilled to share that after months of testing, feedback, and community support, [i]Disc Golf City[/i] is now fully released!   [/p][p][b]What’s new in the Full Release:[/b]  [/p][p]• 🏙️ New courses and city locations to master  [/p][p]• 🎯 Improved disc physics and shot mechanics  [/p][p]• 🎮 Polished UI and smoother controls  [/p][p]• 🏆 Steam Achievements & leaderboards  [/p][p]
A [b]huge thank you[/b] to everyone who joined us during Early Access. Your feedback has been vital in shaping the game into what it is today.  [/p][p][b]
This is just the beginning![/b] [/p][p]We’ll continue supporting [i]Disc Golf City[/i] with updates, events, and new content down the road.  [/p][p]So grab your disc, hit the fairways of the city, and aim for glory.  [/p][p]See you on the streets! 🥏[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634802/e51f3433de15ad956abdf0bb3ba172dd07f581f4.png"][/img][/p]
